title: Market Collapse Sparks Panic
description: In the wake of the Celestial Phenomenon Awakens, industry production has plummeted, leading to an unexpected market collapse. Citizens, fearing for their livelihoods, have begun hoarding resources, further destabilizing the economy.
flavor: Stock markets falter as panic spreads through the trading floors.
response_hint: Implementing fiscal reforms or stabilizing measures could mitigate economic decline.
